title: Choose a new visual direction
question: The fresh roll assigned Viva Docket. Two sources repeated the previous round (Labanotation and Split Flap), so I excluded them instead of reusing a style.

options.label: Viva Docket
options.thesis: An examiner can follow the live evidence from probe to forecast to device without mistaking the demo for a static report.
options.viewport: A cobalt masthead puts freshness and AUTO/MANUAL at the top. A compact five-step evidence rail sits beside a large measured/forecast figure and readable moisture trace. Decision and pump controls remain in a familiar right column. A lower proof strip holds firmware limits, held-out model quality, top features, and simulated/live provenance. One bright active-stage marker advances as the AI state changes.
options.risk: The review-sheet language could feel static; the live trace and changing stage marker must make the running system obvious, with no grades or invented scores.

raised.raise: Keep the current probe value as the one unmistakable focal point.
Separate the manual burst control from read-only evidence so it cannot be activated by accident.

options.label: Science Exhibit
options.thesis: A vivid public-science display makes the sensor-to-action loop instantly memorable without hiding the live readings.
options.viewport: A strong blue product header anchors a clean three-column dashboard: the state chain and conditions on the left, live chart and forecast in the middle, decision and pump on the right. A vivid yellow measured-value field becomes the signature focal point; a compact bottom strip proves safety and model quality.
options.risk: Exhibition graphics can become poster-like; keep ordinary dashboard controls, readable labels, and the full evidence chain in view.

options.label: Transit Route
options.thesis: A single, legible route can connect probe, model, decision, and pump as one live journey.
materials: disciplined route lines and interchange marks
options.viewport: The usual dashboard shell keeps its three work areas. A standard left state rail and center moisture chart lead to a right-side decision and pump column; a single colored route links the current reading to the +15-minute forecast and the device-reported outcome.
options.case: The connected pipeline is exceptionally clear; transit language is familiar, though it does not identify the irrigation subject on its own.
options.risk: There is only one probe and one pump; never imply a larger network or multiple devices.

options.label: Live Gate Board
options.lineage: Airport boarding passes and live departure boards
options.thesis: Freshness and changed states stay visible in a crisp fixed-column live board.
options.viewport: A compact top bar carries link status and reading age. The central chart leads, with the five AI states and event log in a fixed column; decision, device-reported pump state, and the burst control remain grouped to the right.
options.case: Live status and persistent changes map well to telemetry; airport language is a less direct fit than the research setting.
options.risk: Keep timestamps and model values more prominent than any travel-like ornament.

options.label: Streaming Wall
options.lineage: Streaming catalogs with focused title cards
options.thesis: One highlighted tile grows forward while the surrounding wall falls quiet.
options.case: The product has no title artwork or browsing catalog, and the tile interaction hides simultaneous evidence.
options.kept: Give the current reading a single focal position without dimming the rest of the system.

options.label: Dark Console
options.thesis: Dense panel seams and restrained syntax colors make a compact technical workspace.
options.case: It repeats the dark-console look the user asked to leave behind and makes this examiner-facing demo feel like a developer tool.
options.kept: Isolate the manual command from read-only evidence.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A conventional IoT dashboard with a familiar KPI row, line chart, and control panel.
canonCard.viewport: A top navigation bar and compact KPI row lead into a large line chart, with a conventional decision and control panel beside it.
canonCard.risk: Easy to understand, but visually interchangeable with a generic IoT starter dashboard.
